sentences.en: "Come into my parlor," said the spider to the fly.
sentences.zh: 蜘蛛对苍蝇说：‘跟我来我的客厅。’

sentences.en: There's a huge spider in the room! Quick, exterminate it!
sentences.zh: 房间里有一只大蜘蛛！快，把它消灭了!

sentences.en: Birds have nests, spiders have webs, and humans have friendship.
sentences.zh: 鸟儿有巢穴，蜘蛛有蛛网，人类有友谊。
